book.name: LOMA
book.title: Loma wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Avala Keliso Ta Yaomal inoke Logugui Nige Ni Kukuhikagila
Taliwau ge nuwau, komiu gegewemiu logugui ana kamwasa ku atena, inoke no baaba hiwe ku atena ya: logugui gamagalau yawaliliya miminana ya te i logugui-agil.

Abapapatini etega i ola hiwe: logugui i ba toalolon meluyovana ni miminaa ya te lagona eliyana sauga tau iyoho yawalina miminana. Yaa ebo tau ni yaomal, he alolon ana logugui nige al yova ni kukuhikan.

Inoke ebo yova lagona iyoho nigeya ga i yayaomal ge tau getoga ni alolonan, yaka logugui i ba iya toganawal. Yaa ebo lagona ni yaomal, alolon ana logugui nige al i kukuhikan. Inoke ebo tau getoga etega ni alolonan, nige i gaganawal to.

Inoke taliwau ge nuwau, i ola al to komiu kaiwemiu. Keliso wana yaomal eliyana yawalimiu bebeyaunana iyaka i yaomal ge Logugui nige al i kukuhikagimiu. Yaka sauga ya ku minaa tau toto Yehoba i palutem yaomala, inoke yawalila enona ni gan Yehoba kaiwena.
Valila tuwala yawalina i logugui-agila, inoke saugena o Logugui gegi nuwatuina i palutil tuwala gamwanaa. Yaka gegi amnanina o i tuwalali tuwala elana, ge wala ginol o enona i masal ta yaomal.

Valila Logugui i yowanila, yaa Keliso wana yaomal eliyana yawalila bebeyaunana iyaka i yaomal, inoke sauga ya Logugui nige al i kukuhikagila. Inoke wala tuwalali Yehoba elana, ta golugoluwa kamwasa vavaluna toto Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i pankitela, nige ta golugoluwa kamwasa bebeyaunana toto Logugui i pankitela.
Logugui Alona Gegi wali Tuwalali Bana

Kaiwena Logugui gegi nuwatuina i palutil tuwala gamwanaa, inoke tabam enuna nihi ba, “Age logugui iya bugul nanakina i ola gegi?” Analiya na lahe na ba, “Nigeya hot! Logugui iya bugul waiwaisana.” He logugui eliyana te gegi ana sapu ya atena. Binimala logugui nige ni babaa, “Bahi matamomoni,” he matamomoni ana sapu nige na aatena.
Yaa gegi wana kamwasa etega i pwawa, inoke logugui o eliyana matamomoni amnanina tomaha ge tomaha i palutil eliyau. Binimala nige logugui ni gagan, gegi nige wana gasisi.
Valila yawaliu i gan, yaa abwe logugui ya atena, yaka gegi wana gasisi i gan,
inoke ya yaomal. Inoke nau no aatena eliyana, ya pwawa logugui toto tage yawal ni pem, iya te yaomal i pwatanim.
Kaiwena gegi wana kamwasa etega i pwawaa logugui eliyana, yaka gegi i kakaweyau, logugui i patuwalali ge ya yaomal.
Inoke Logugui gegewena i bwabwalena, ge gamwanaa maisena ge maisena i bwabwalena, i sapu ge i waisi.

He ga i ola? Age Logugui, iya bugul waiwaisana, i payaomal-agau? Nigeya hot! Yaa gegi bugul waiwaisana i patuwalali inoke no abayaomal i ginol, inoke toto ya kaiwena gamagalau gegi wana ginol hot nihi atena. Inoke logugui eliyana i mwananal te gegi iya bugul nanakina hot.
Nak toto Ta Totowani Heiya te Ta Giginol
Inoke ta atena te logugui i neem Yehoba Yayaluwana elana; yaa nau ya olak tuwau yawalina elana, inoke ya ola gegi wana tololoyowan.
Nige ya aatena te hauna ya giginol. Kaiwena toto nuwau na ginol, he nige ya giginol, ge toto ya totowani, heiya te ya giginol.
He ebo toto ya totowani na ginol, inoke no aatena eliyana ya patunahot te logugui iya i waisi.
Yaa nige tage nau hot ginol bolo ya ya ginolil, gegi toto i miminaa atewa, iya te i ginolil.
Ya atena waisi nige i miminaa nau panayawi gamagalina eliyau, kaiwena nuwau waisi paganina na ginol, yaa nige bosowaiu.
Waisi toto nuwau na ginol, he nige ya giginol, ge nak toto ya towani, heiya te ya giginol.
Inoke ebo toto ya totowani na ginol, he nige tage nau hot ginol bolo ya ya ginolil, yaa gegi toto i miminaa atewa, iya te i ginolil.
Inoke no kite pwawa i ola hiwe: sauga ebo nuwau waisi na ginol, yaka nak i mikelaubwa eliyau ge na ginol.
Atewa Yehoba wana logugui ya yaliyaya-an,
yaa ya atena nuwatu etega al iyoho i tuwatuwalali tuwawa, ge alona ateu wana nuwatu hot hi lohalohaveyan. He gegi nuwatuina te i tuwatuwalali tuwawa ge i paloloyowan-agau.

Inoke i ola hiwe: ebo nau totou inoke atewa tage Yehoba wana logugui na henapuan, yaa tuwau toto panayawi tuwanina gegi nuwatuina i henapuan. Eeu! Nau geb, gamagal nuwanuwanakina! Henala ni pwamwalau tuwan ya elana, tuwan toto yaomal i pwatanim? Ya ba mulolu Yehoba elana kaiwena iya bosowaina ni pwamwalau wala Babala Yeisu Keliso eliyana.
